display.title: Episode 295: The Shpoler Zeide and the Strange Pillar of Fire (Vov Tishrei)
display.summary_short: A Vov Tishrei show for the yahrzeit of the Shpoler Zeide: his own march, Shema with two Beis Rivkah girls, the story of the strange pillar of fire, and a talk with one of his descendants.
display.summary_long: Broadcast on Vov Tishrei 5748, the yahrzeit of Rabbi Aryeh Leib of Shpola, the Shpoler Zeide. Uncle Yossi wishes everyone a good and sweet year and explains how the Shpoler Zeide's descendants mark the day by retelling his stories and following his example. The weekly march is the Hopkozak, a tune composed by the Shpoler Zeide himself. Two girls from the Beis Rivkah school lead the Shema. Story time brings 'The Strange Pillar of Fire': on a visit to the Alter Rebbe, the Shpoler Zeide reads a holy manuscript, the 'Book for the Righteous', and begs that it be returned to Heaven, saying it will rise in a pillar of fire and wishing that his own soul would rise the same way. Years later a fire breaks out in the Alter Rebbe's house, a pillar of fire rises to the sky, and at that very moment the Shpoler Zeide passes away. A descendant of the Shpoler Zeide then describes the family society that collects his stories and traces his descendants. The show closes with a request for letters about Rosh Hashanah and an invitation to a Sukkos event.
display.lesson: Remember the tzaddikim on their yahrzeit by retelling their stories and following their example of Ahavas Yisroel.
